issue_context.title: Functionality to pass first few tokens as input to the decoder in T5 model
issue_context.body: I am finetuning the T5 model on a downstream sequence to sequence task. I wanted to know if it is possible to pass first few tokens as input to the T5 decoder during inference (like it is done in text generation models) apart from the input provided to the encoder?
